Thus crime: "传播淫秽物品罪" or "出售淫秽物品罪". In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "传播淫秽物品罪" (selling, distributing). The examples: earlier they used "容留他人吸毒" exactly phrase. The key rule: use exact phrase from facts. The fact says "收购淫秽影碟出售牟利". So the crime is "贩卖淫秽物品". The standard name: "贩卖淫秽物品罪". Should we include "制作"? No, only selling. So output: [罪名]贩卖淫秽物品罪<eoa>.
